intro: ForzaTAPE® T461 is an extremely aggressive heavy coat weight synthetic rubber transfer tape with a natural kraft liner. It is designed for mounting and bonding insulation panels, trim, and edging applications.
features: Heavy coat weight — 20 mil adhesive thickness
High peel adhesion — 7.5 lbs @ 1 mil/in of width
Natural kraft liner for easy handling and release
Transfer tape construction — no carrier, for clean lamination
applications_lead: ForzaTAPE® T461 is specifically designed for:
applications: Mounting and bonding insulation panels to a variety of substrates
Fixing edging, trim, and decorative panels
General laminating and mounting in insulation applications
substrates_lead: ForzaTAPE® T461 is used to mount and bond:

left_sections.title: Surface Preparation
paragraphs: Ensure substrate is clean and dry and free from dust, dirt, oil, wax, or silicone.
Allow any cleaning solvents to fully evaporate before applying the tape to ensure optimal adhesion.

left_sections.title: Application Instructions
paragraphs: Apply the tape to the part to be bonded, ensuring that no air is trapped between the tape and the substrate. Apply adequate pressure using a J roller, using a recommended application pressure of 15 pounds per inch of tape width, and apply with care to avoid wrinkles or trapped air.
At the point of final assembly or lamination, remove the release liner and apply with care to avoid wrinkles or trapped air.
Bond strength continues to build over the hours following application as the adhesive fully wets out the substrate, so allow adequate dwell time before placing the assembly into service.

left_sections.title: Clean Up Information
paragraphs: Unapplied tape may be removed cleanly from surfaces. Any adhesive residue can be removed using isopropyl alcohol, mineral spirits, or an appropriate adhesive remover. Once the adhesive has fully bonded, removal may require mechanical methods such as scraping or abrasion.

left_sections.title: Storage & Disposal
paragraphs: Store material in original unopened packaging at temperatures between 40°F and 100°F. Shelf life is 12 months when stored as recommended.
Dispose of in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.

precautionary.text: This product is classified as Non-Hazardous under GHS.
